description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests designed to evaluate the performance of rebasing operations in a Git repository. It sets up multiple repositories and commits large numbers of changes to simulate real-world scenarios, then measures the performance of rebasing on top of different branches with and without the split-index feature enabled.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or sets up the default repository environment for performance testing.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for creating large files and diffs.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates a passage of time or a tick between commits.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, running the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
